selection.development: 2024GW6-13 warm prefix, GW14-21 chronological validation; all fitted labels known<deadline
selection.objective: team xG quasi-Poisson deviance, no target lineup/minutes/results used in gate inputs
limitations: Reused research seasons; no pristine holdout
Historical publication clocks remain kickoff+3/4h proxies
Frozen player profile hyperparameters selected in preceding 2024 development; no change to baseline
Gate training uses analytic expected-exposure xG forecasts, not full-simulator point loss
Profile variance is conditional EB and omits correlated role/MM/context uncertainty
All arms retain IDENTICAL original legacy own-goal/CS and special-assist scoring; no mixed correctness flags
Legal XI reuses existing sampler; vacancies may persist; survival zero-minute starter draws use existing one-minute floor
Return-from-absence proxy is not verified injury evidence
No complete six-GW candidate TS replay; locked2125 benchmark unchanged
